topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon this list, just lying there on the bedroom table, and I couldn't help but read it. It's not like I was snooping, I swear. I was just... curious, you know? And now I can't stop thinking about all the things on it, all the dreams and places and crazy adventures they’ve dreamed of. It’s got me wondering, is this the life they want, or are they just biding their time? I wish they'd shared it with me, talked it through. I feel like I’ve missed out on something important, like I should have been the one to hear it all firsthand. I’m going to find the right moment to bring it up, to show them I care and I’m here to support whatever they dream of.
